script: Voice-over comes from text-to-speech. Choose one voice and keep it for the whole channel, so viewers recognise you. Write short sentences, check pronunciation, then normalise loudness to about minus sixteen L U F S. Listen to every voice-over before you use it, on both speakers and earphones.
